subject.title: fix(discord): account-scoped voice groups + delayed autoJoin safety net

question: After the branch is refreshed and focused tests are updated, should OpenClaw accept delayed Discord voice autoJoin retries plus account-scoped @discordjs/voice groups for the bundled Discord plugin?
rationale: The code follows the dependency-supported group contract, but it changes Discord voice startup timing and session ownership in a real transport path, so owner intent is needed before accepting the merge risk.

options.title: Accept After Refresh And Proof
options.body: Keep the account-scoped group and delayed retries, but require a clean merge, focused timer/group tests, and refreshed Discord voice proof before merge.

options.title: Keep Current Timing
options.body: Reject or replace the delayed retries if maintainers prefer the existing READY/RESUMED timing contract and want a narrower group-only fix.

options.title: Pause For A Smaller Follow-Up
options.body: Ask for a narrower PR if the contributor cannot refresh and prove both single-account and multi-account voice behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept After Refresh And Proof
recommendation.body: Keep the account-scoped group and delayed retries, but require a clean merge, focused timer/group tests, and refreshed Discord voice proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has recent merged history in the Discord voice autoJoin path and is the current live assignee for this PR.
